messages:
Vikram: quick check — where are we on onboarding orchid-13b and ozark-3b for the catalog? need final license signoff + perf profiles before the catalog freeze on Mon.
Olga: I can own the license review for both. will start a compatibility checklist today. ping me if you saw any weird model README clauses.
Maria: I’ll take perf runs. planning to run seq=1024 and 2048 passes on p4d and v100 to get latency + mem curves. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Vikram: awesome. @olga please flag any non-commercial / redistribution clauses — Riya will need the exact text.
Riya: thanks — pls mention if there are model weights with third-party tokenizers (I’ll need vendor contact). for orchid-13b the license looks like a modified MIT w/ no-redistribution for weights; sending snippet in DM.
Olga: noted. I’ll post the exact clause here if it’s blocking. preliminary: weights redistribution clause => legal review required, could push to Private-only initially.
Model-Ingest-Bot: intake created #4321 for orchid-13b (submitted by @data-team). metadata: family=transformer; params=13B; quant-ready=true.
Model-Ingest-Bot: intake created #4322 for ozark-3b (submitted by @research). metadata: family=transformer; params=3B; license=unknown.
Simon: FYI eng-platform — if Maria needs p4d quota bump for parallel runs, that’s a dependency. @sam-infra can we pre-allocate ~2x p4d for 24h window?
Sam-Infra: can do but need exact window and owner. maria — what start/stop times?
Maria: planning to start 10:00 PT tomorrow, ~8h batch + follow-ups. will require GPU access + access to perf buckets (perf-results/orchid13b/*).
Sam-Infra: granted provisional quota for 10:00–18:00 PT, created request INC-9923 for permanent increases if needed.
Vikram: perfect. Maria, when you run please tag perf ids like perf/orchid-13b/v1 and perf/ozark-3b/v1 so console picks them up.
Maria: will do. quick command I’ll run (sharing so infra can whitelist):
```
./run_profile.sh --model orchid-13b --seq 1024,2048 --batch 8 --devices p4d --out perf/orchid-13b/v1 --quant pgq
```
Olga: @riya once Legal signs off, I’ll update registry metadata and mark license_status=approved or private_only. any preference for how to surface "private-only" in the catalog UI?
Riya: prefer explicit badge "Restricted weights — contact legal" + link to support flow. keep it visible for sales/AE screening.
Vikram: milestone checklist for Monday launch decision:
- license_status (Olga) — must be approved or tagged restricted
- perf_profiles (Maria) — must have p50/p95 latency + mem + cost estimates
- infra quotas (Sam) — temporary quota for perf runs
- ingest metadata (Model-Ingest-Bot/Olga) — checksum, tokenizer, model-card
If any item is red we gate that model from public catalog.
Olga: I’ll update license_status by EOD tomorrow after the DM thread with Riya.
Maria: perf runs scheduled, will post results as CSV links in this thread and add console tags.
Simon: platform note — if we mark restricted, Dedicated/DedicatedPrivate routing will automatically route to customer-only variants. no infra work needed.
Vikram: thanks everyone. if you hit blockers drop a quick note here. otherwise I’ll prepare rollout checklist on Friday.
Olga: ack :thumbsup:
Maria: ack :rocket:
Riya: ack, will review license text tonight.
Model-Ingest-Bot: ingest pipeline check passed for orchid-13b (checksum OK)."
